data.one_liner: A horizontal menu bar widget for Flutter supporting nested submenus, checkboxes, and radio items.
data.what_it_does: PlutoMenuBar provides a horizontal navigation menu bar for Flutter applications. It supports multi-level submenus, custom styling, hover or tap activation modes, dividers, checkboxes, and radio menu items.
use_when: You need a desktop or web style horizontal menu bar with dropdown submenus.
You want support for interactive menu items like checkboxes and radio buttons.
avoid_when: You are building a standard mobile application where a drawer or bottom navigation bar is more appropriate.
You need native OS application menu bars.
strengths: Provides both hover and tap open modes.
Includes built-in support for dividers, checkboxes, and radio button items.
weaknesses: Limited to horizontal menu bar layouts.
No built-in native desktop OS menu integration.
